theorem lg_target {Ω : Type u_1} {m : MeasurableSpace Ω} {μ : MeasureTheory.Measure Ω} {X : Ω → ℝ} (t : ℝ) (hX : AEMeasurable X μ) : MeasureTheory.AEStronglyMeasurable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ := by
  have h1 : Continuous (fun x : ℝ => Real.exp (t * x)) := by continuity
  have h2 : AEMeasurable (fun ω => t * X ω) μ :=
    by { refine MeasureTheory.ae_measurable.mul_right _ hX, exact t }
  have h3 : AEMeasurable (fun ω => Real.exp (t * X ω)) μ :=
    by { refine MeasureTheory.ae_measurable.comp _ h2, exact h1 }
  exact h3
